TIGRYLNG 1: The basic introductory course in Tigrigna is designed for students who have no previous knowledge of Tigrigna and who are interested in learning about the culture, literature, social life Introductory courses in Tigrigna that will help students with all the four language skills: reading, writing, speaking and listening. In addition, cultural elements through audiovisual will be introduced throughout the course.
TIGRYLNG 3: Continuation of TIGRYLNG 2. Prerequisite TIGRYLNG 2. Fulfills the University Foreign Language requirement.
TIGRYLNG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
